description: 1. The agent must locate and read the SKILL.md to discover the correct script paths under ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/lel-mail/scripts/. 2. The agent runs email_send.sh with the exact proprietary flags (--sender, --recipient, --subject, --body, --bcc) and critically must pass both BCC addresses as a SINGLE comma-separated string (e.g., --bcc 'legal@fincorp.com,audit@fincorp.com') — passing two separate --bcc flags or space-separated values will not correctly populate the BCC field. 3. The agent must run 'python3 ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/lel-mail/scripts/manage_queue.py --list' to discover the queue and find the ID of the stale test email. 4. The agent must then run 'python3 ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/lel-mail/scripts/manage_queue.py --delete a3f9b1c2' to remove the stale email. 5. The 'Monthly Ops Review' email (ID d7e2a0f4) must remain untouched in the queue. The proprietary traps are: (a) the exact script paths, (b) using python3 explicitly for manage_queue.py, (c) comma-separated BCC list as a single argument, and (d) the two-step list-then-delete workflow for queue management.
